svg.title: Autoscaler oscillation from delay and over-correction
svg.text: Autoscaler: Correct by k Times the Error, Seen d Steps Late
k = 0.6, delay 2: rings, dies down very slowly
k = 0.8, delay 2: swings grow, then slam between 0 and about 250
Rule: x(n+1) = x(n) + k (100 - x(n-d)). With d = 2, any k above 0.618 makes the swings grow.
